Next, centrifuge the overnight solubilized brain homogenate at 20,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C. Without disturbing the pellet, transfer the solubilized brain supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube using a 1,000 µL pipette tip. Preclear the brain supernatant by adding 100 µL of 50% slurry of pre-washed Pierce Protein A/G agarose (prepared in steps C1–C4), and rock on benchtop rocker at 24 rpm for 1 h at 4 °C. Spin the supernatant at 1,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C to pellet the agarose. Without disturbing the agarose, carefully transfer the precleared supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube using a 1,000 µL pipette tip. Measure the relative quantity of total protein using Bio-Rad protein assay according to the manufacturer’s instructions (see detailed protocol at https://www.bio-rad.com/webroot/web/pdf/lsr/literature/LIT33.pdf ; 1.5 mL plastic cuvettes and a spectrophotometer are required). Note: For the blank solution, mix equal quantities of homogenization buffer and solubilization buffer that were saved at 4 °C from DAY ONE, steps B4 and B

To set up IPs, transfer 400 µL of precleared brain supernatant to each of two new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes (this is approximately 1–2 mg total protein/IP). Note: If comparing IPs from different samples, be sure to immunoprecipitate an equal quantity of total protein in an equal volume. The minimum volume for an IP is 200 µL. Also, use the precleared extract for immunoprecipitation immediately. Do not freeze the precleared supernatant or the protein complexes will fall apart, and co-IP of associated proteins will fail. Add 2 µg of antibody per IP. Note: Anywhere from 0.5–5 µg can be used, depending on the efficiency of the antibody. Rock the IPs on a benchtop rocker at 24 rpm, overnight at 4 °C. DAY THREE—Capture immunoprecipitates Centrifuge the IPs at 1,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C. Add 30 µL of 50% slurry of pre-washed Pierce Protein A/G agarose (prepared in DAY TWO steps C1–C4 and stored at 4 °C) to each IP. Rock IPs on a benchtop rocker at 24 rpm for 1 h at 4 °C. Centrifuge IPs at 1,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C. Remove supernatant with a 1,000 µL pipette tip without disturbing the agarose. Add 1 mL of IP wash buffer to the agarose and invert several times. Spin 1,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C. Repeat wash steps D5–D7 two more times, using new IP wash buffer each time. On the last wash, completely remove the wash buffer from the agarose using a 200 µL pipette tip, followed by a flattened 10 µL gel loading tip. Add 20 µL of 2× loading buffer. Boil extract sample and immunoprecipitations for 3 min at 95 °C. Note: Boiling may cause aggregation of membrane proteins. In this case, alternative options include omitting step D11 or heating the samples at 65 °C for 10 min instead. Best results need to be empirically determined per experiment. Continue with protein analysis as desired, e.g., SDS-PAGE and western blot (Towbin et al., 1979; Sambrook and Russell, 2006 ; Ni et al., 2017). Note: The subsequent protein analysis steps are dependent upon the equipment available. For a comprehensive guide, see https://www.bio-rad.com/webroot/web/pdf/lsr/literature/Bulletin_6040.pdf .

steps.title: Make 1 M HEPES pH 7.5
steps.instruction: Dissolve 119.15 g HEPES (MW 238.5 g·mol⁻¹) in 400 mL ultrapure water, adjust pH to 7.5 with 10 N NaOH, then bring the volume to 500 mL with ultrapure water.

steps.title: Make 5 M NaCl
steps.instruction: Dissolve 146 g NaCl (MW 58.44 g·mol⁻¹) in 400 mL ultrapure water and bring the volume to 500 mL with ultrapure water.

steps.title: Make 0.5 M EDTA pH 8.0
steps.instruction: Dissolve 18.61 g disodium EDTA·2H₂O (MW 372.24 g·mol⁻¹) in 80 mL ultrapure water, adjust pH to 8.0 with NaOH pellets, then bring the volume to 100 mL with ultrapure water.

steps.title: Make 0.5 M EGTA pH 8.0
steps.instruction: Dissolve 19.02 g EGTA (MW 380.35 g·mol⁻¹) in 80 mL ultrapure water, adjust pH to 8.0 with 4 N NaOH, then bring the volume to 100 mL with ultrapure water.

steps.title: Make 1 M DTT aliquots
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.5 g DTT in 8 mL ultrapure water, adjust volume to 10 mL, aliquot into 1 mL portions and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Homogenization buffer (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 1 mL 1 M HEPES pH 7.5, 1.5 mL 5 M NaCl, 0.5 mL 0.5 M EDTA, 0.5 mL 0.5 M EGTA, and 46.5 mL ultrapure water. Mix well; keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Solubilization buffer (25 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 0.5 mL 1 M HEPES pH 7.5, 0.75 mL 5 M NaCl, 0.25 mL 0.5 M EDTA, 0.25 mL 0.5 M EGTA, and 1 g n‑Octyl‑β‑D‑Glucopyranoside; adjust final volume to 25 mL with ultrapure water. The buffer contains 4 % detergent.

steps.title: Prepare Preclear buffer (10 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 5 mL Homogenization buffer, 5 mL Solubilization buffer, 5 mM EDTA, 5 mM EGTA, and 2 % n‑Octyl‑β‑D‑Glucopyranoside (final concentration).

steps.title: Prepare IP wash buffer (25 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 23.75 mL Homogenization buffer, 1.25 mL Solubilization buffer, 5 mM EDTA, 5 mM EGTA, and 0.2 % n‑Octyl‑β‑D‑Glucopyranoside.

steps.title: Make 2× loading buffer (1 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 0.5 mL 4× Laemmli sample buffer, 0.2 mL 1 M DTT, 0.3 mL ultrapure water (final DTT concentration 200 mM).

steps.title: Dissect and snap‑freeze brains
steps.instruction: Euthanize adult zebrafish according to IACUC guidelines, dissect each brain, place it in an Eppendorf tube, close tightly, and immerse the tube in liquid nitrogen for ≥1 min. Store individual frozen brains at –80 °C (up to 2 years) until use.

steps.title: Day 1 – Prepare buffers for homogenization
steps.instruction: On ice, prepare 5 mL Homogenization buffer by adding one Pierce protease‑inhibitor mini tablet and 5 µL 1 M DTT; keep on ice (use within 60 min). Prepare 5 mL Solubilization buffer by adding 5 µL 1 M DTT; keep on ice (use within 60 min).

steps.title: Day 1 – Homogenize brains
steps.instruction: Place five frozen brains in an ice‑cold 1 mL Dounce tissue grinder, add 0.5 mL ice‑cold Homogenization buffer, and dounce 10–20 strokes with the loose pestle followed by 10–20 strokes with the tight pestle. Transfer the 0.5 mL homogenate to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 0.5 mL Solubilization buffer, gently invert to mix (final detergent concentration = 2 %). Rock the tube on a benchtop rocker at 24 rpm overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Day 2 – Pre‑wash Protein A/G agarose
steps.instruction: Wash a 250 µL bed of Pierce Protein A/G agarose with 1 mL Preclear buffer, spin 1,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant; repeat wash two more times with fresh Preclear buffer. After the final wash, resuspend the agarose in 250 µL Preclear buffer to obtain a 500 µL 50 % slurry. Store at 4 °C until used (sufficient for three preparations).

steps.title: Day 2 – Clarify solubilized extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the overnight solubilized brain homogenate at 20,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C. Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Day 2 – Preclear supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of the 50 % agarose slurry to the supernatant, rock at 24 rpm for 1 h at 4 °C, then spin 1,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C. Transfer the cleared supernatant to a fresh tube without disturbing the agarose pellet.

steps.title: Day 2 – Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure total protein using the Bio‑Rad protein assay according to the manufacturer’s protocol (requires 1.5 mL plastic cuvettes and a spectrophotometer). For the blank, mix equal volumes of the saved Homogenization buffer and Solubilization buffer from steps B4 and B7. Save a 40 µL aliquot of the precleared supernatant, add 40 µL 2× loading buffer, and store at –20 °C for later SDS‑PAGE.

steps.title: Day 2 – Set up immunoprecipitations
steps.instruction: Aliquot 400 µL of precleared supernatant into each of two 1.5 mL tubes (≈1–2 mg total protein per IP; minimum IP volume = 200 µL). Add 2 µg of the chosen antibody to each tube (0.5–5 µg acceptable). Rock the IPs at 24 rpm overnight at 4 °C. Do not freeze the precleared supernatant.

steps.title: Day 3 – Capture immune complexes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the overnight IPs at 1,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C. Add 30 µL of the 50 % agarose slurry to each tube, rock at 24 rpm for 1 h at 4 °C, then spin 1,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C. Remove supernatant with a 1,000 µL pipette tip without disturbing the agarose.

steps.title: Day 3 – Wash immunoprecipitates
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL IP wash buffer to each tube, invert several times, then spin 1,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C. Repeat the wash two additional times (total three washes) using fresh IP wash buffer each time.

steps.title: Day 3 – Elute and denature samples
steps.instruction: After the final wash, remove all wash buffer using a 200 µL pipette tip followed by a flattened 10 µL gel‑loading tip. Add 20 µL 2× loading buffer, then boil the samples for 3 min at 95 °C (alternatively, heat at 65 °C for 10 min if membrane protein aggregation occurs). Proceed to SDS‑PAGE and downstream analysis (e.g., western blot).
